title: Invalid numerical contributions can be dropped or replaced
evidence: Nonfinite marginal terms become NA; invalid copula terms can become 1; only finite terms are summed
consequence: The optimized objective can change its effective sample with parameter values
action: Use a fixed missingness-only inclusion mask; evaluate stable log contributions; reject invalid included terms with -Inf; add adversarial likelihood tests
acceptance: Included marginal and pair counts are invariant over parameter proposals and independent calculations match package log-likelihoods

title: Hessian checks can convert invalid curvature into finite standard errors
evidence: Standard errors use absolute diagonal values and curvature sign is not enforced
consequence: Saddle points or unidentified fits can appear to have valid inference
action: Remove absolute-value masking; register numerical rank, condition-number, signed-eigenvalue, and gradient thresholds; fail inference with a classed condition when any threshold fails
acceptance: Boundary tests at each registered threshold pass; singular and indefinite Hessians fail; valid analytical and numerical Hessians agree with unmasked SEs

title: Intermittent gaps are not handled by the claimed observed-data likelihood and the dropout study is not dropout
evidence: Observed visits separated by a missing visit are split rather than integrated; time_mar uses rowwise Bernoulli deletion; 90 of 480 fits failed
consequence: Claims about MAR, dropout, ordinary likelihood criteria, and robustness are unsupported
action: Support ordinary likelihood only for complete panels and ignorable observed prefixes/monotone dropout; flag interior gaps as a segmented composite objective, disable ordinary AIC/BIC and model-based Hessian inference for those fits, and allow sandwich/bootstrap only as sensitivity tools; add genuine monotone dropout and disclose all failures
acceptance: Three/four-visit tests verify the documented segmented objective rather than an integrated likelihood; interior-gap fits carry a classed composite flag and AIC/BIC errors; complete/prefix likelihood tests pass; simulated dropout is monotone; attempt/failure counts reconcile

title: Headline recovery design does not match staged evidence
evidence: Manuscript states n=250/1000, T=5/20, and 1000 replicates; staged assets are n=500, T=4, and 100 replicates
consequence: Readers cannot know which experiment supports recovery, coverage, and runtime claims
action: Choose the actual target design, regenerate it, and generate scenario metadata and manuscript design tables from attempt-level inputs
acceptance: For every artifact, scenario ID, n, T, attempted/successful replicates, seeds, and exclusions agree automatically across manuscript and data

title: Optimizer comparison mixes incompatible designs and overstates conclusions
evidence: Normal has 10 replicates while Gamma/NBI have 100; scenario dimensions differ by family; several stated directions contradict tables
consequence: User-facing optimizer guidance lacks a valid causal contrast
action: Replace with a paired factorial design varying one dimension at a time across families; report uncertainty, sign probabilities, runtime, convergence, and failures
acceptance: Generated scenario table matches every input; each contrast changes only its named factor; narrative direction checks pass

title: Frozen paper is an annotated internal draft and unresolved decisions remain
evidence: Visible red notes/TODOs remain and substantive choices are unresolved
consequence: The paper is not a reviewable scientific record
action: Resolve every author question, remove all draft macros/notes, and produce a clean manuscript snapshot after the evidence and architecture are final
acceptance: Searches find zero draft/TODO/revision-note content; a decision log accounts for each removed note; the final source and PDF agree

title: Implemented replication workflow and manuscript instructions are not yet aligned or fully accepted
evidence: Manuscript names expanded and claims all results exact; full/tolerance/CI gates remain incomplete; workflow inputs are not yet in a cloneable state
consequence: A reviewer cannot rely on the written commands or current acceptance status
action: Rewrite Section 6 around smoke/paper/full and the exact LIPID exception; track the complete workflow; wire full metric-level tolerance checks; archive clean paper/full/resume and Windows/Ubuntu evidence before release
acceptance: Fresh Windows and Ubuntu clones pass smoke/paper; the canonical platform passes full from empty checkpoints and resume with zero repeated fits; all declared tolerance checks and public artifact mappings pass

title: Parameter scales and applied interpretations are incomplete or incorrect
locations: Sections 2.2 and 5; Tables 2-3 and 15; LIPID prose
evidence: Links/domains/caps are incompletely documented; location is called mean; dependence is called correlation; LIPID theta/tail interpretations conflict with fitted scale and displayed values
consequence: Users can report the wrong estimand or make invalid scientific claims
action: Publish a family-specific estimand/link table with inverse links, domains, bounds, independence and tail transforms; rewrite all clinical interpretations on natural and Kendall/tail scales
acceptance: Every coefficient and plot identifies link and natural scale; automated examples reproduce reported transformations; no generic correlation language is used incorrectly

title: Advertised logLik and vcov methods violate standard R contracts
evidence: logLik/vcov outputs do not consistently satisfy scalar/class/attribute and coefficient-alignment contracts
consequence: AIC/BIC and downstream R tooling can be incorrect or unusable
action: Return a scalar classed logLik with finite df/nobs, scalar finite AIC/BIC where the objective permits them, and a named covariance matrix aligned exactly with coef; add generic contract tests
acceptance: Standard generics and downstream model-comparison tests pass for ordinary-likelihood fits; composite-gap fits reject AIC/BIC with the documented classed condition

title: Discrete PIT/Rosenblatt and automatic pass/fail rules are invalid or uncalibrated
evidence: Discrete checks use upper CDF rather than randomized PIT; KS dependence/parameter estimation is ignored; manuscript reverses the p-value inequality
consequence: Correct models may fail and misspecified models may pass
action: Implement reproducible randomized discrete residuals where supported; remove formal pass/fail language and fixed thresholds from check_model; return descriptive flags with documented limitations and explicitly report higher-lag diagnostics as unavailable when not computed
acceptance: Tests verify randomized residual reproducibility and distribution under representative correct models; output/help/manuscript contain no unqualified pass/fail claim; the p-value inequality is correct; higher-lag availability is explicit

title: Novelty and comparator landscape are incomplete and too categorical
evidence: Closest multivariate distributional and copula software is omitted; GEE/GLMM/vine capabilities are sometimes characterized inaccurately
consequence: An editor may view the uniqueness claim as unresearched or advocacy-driven
action: Perform a dated landscape review and rewrite novelty as a bounded frequentist shared-formula first-order longitudinal joint-likelihood contribution
acceptance: Every plausible near-neighbor is compared or excluded with evidence; no absolute no-software claim remains

title: Paper needs a software-first JSS structure and shorter main narrative
evidence: Software use begins on page 11; extensive derivations and simulations dominate 47 pages; JSS discourages extensive simulation studies
consequence: The package contribution and intended user are obscured
action: Aim for a 24-28 page main article with bounded introduction, concise model/data contract, package design, progressive workflow, focused evaluation, brief secondary application, and availability/limitations; move derivations and grids to supplement
acceptance: Executable software appears by page 6-7; the public workflow is the largest main-text component; secondary grids/derivations are outside the main article; an editor can state the software contribution after the abstract and introduction

title: Primary public example is too maximalist and does not match its producer
evidence: First fit combines BCPE/t, six formulas and smooths; producer analysis differs from displayed guided example
consequence: Readers cannot distinguish essential syntax and review cannot tie figures to code
action: Use one named simulated/public dataset and a progressive simple-to-advanced workflow; make the exact manuscript code generate the displayed figures and output
acceptance: First fit is under 12 lines; each added feature answers a diagnostic/scientific need; one script reproduces all example output

title: Nearest software alternatives and fair task-based comparisons are missing
evidence: Main recovery baseline ignores dependence and GEE benchmark uses restricted/unstable settings; closest copula/distributional workflows are not adequately positioned
consequence: Evidence shows dependence can beat independence but not advancement over the relevant software frontier
action: Create a dated capability table for all near-neighbor classes and run only one or two fair tractable task-based benchmarks selected to test the bounded contribution; document non-equivalence or infeasibility rather than forcing a comparison
acceptance: Capability claims are source-backed; each retained empirical comparator uses the same estimand/data and reports accuracy, runtime, convergence and limitations; excluded comparisons have a precise reason

title: Uncertainty, denominators, and failure accounting are inadequate
evidence: Many cells have 20 or 100 attempts; MCSEs/intervals and attempted/successful counts are absent; failure conditioning differs by method
consequence: Small differences and positive conclusions exceed experiment precision
action: Publish attempt-level states and report attempted/converged/included counts, MCSEs or paired intervals, conditional and failure-penalized summaries, and prespecified outlier rules
acceptance: Every estimate displays denominator and Monte Carlo uncertainty; totals reconcile across attempt, metric, and summary files

title: Selection counts are stale and AIC reliability is overgeneralized
evidence: Manuscript 10/60 counts differ from staged 100-replicate cells; moderate Gaussian selection is uncertain
consequence: Displayed conclusions do not describe current data
action: Regenerate confusion matrices and prose from current attempt-level results; qualify by generator, dependence and sample size; discuss close-AIC sensitivity
acceptance: All counts sum to cell attempts and are generated automatically; reliability claims are scenario-specific with uncertainty

title: CG algorithm description and empirical guidance do not match evidence
evidence: Appendix acceptance equations differ from code; staged optimizer evidence compares RS joint/separate but not CG
consequence: Users cannot reproduce or trust CG guidance
action: Rewrite Appendix A from the implemented objective/steps; retain CG as an alternate optimizer but remove interchangeability, relative-speed, and sensitivity recommendations unless supported by a small precision-driven paired benchmark
acceptance: A deterministic one-iteration test matches every documented candidate and acceptance step; any retained empirical CG statement is linked to the focused benchmark with denominator and uncertainty; unsupported Table 7 claims are absent

title: Longitudinal ordering, pairing, gaps, and pair-covariate endpoint semantics are underspecified
evidence: time_var/subject_var do not define ties, irregular spacing, scheduled versus observed adjacency, or which row supplies pair covariates
consequence: Equivalent datasets can yield different likelihoods and interpretations
action: Formalize the conditional Markov model and pairing algorithm; define ordering, duplicates, gaps, left/right endpoint mapping, and dependence per visit versus time unit
acceptance: A six-row toy panel documents exact marginal/pair contributions and matches model matrices, likelihood, simulation, and prediction

title: LIPID is too long, not exactly auditable, and overinterpreted
evidence: 10% subsample, selection and missingness are insufficiently justified; nominal post-selection p-values and stability/treatment claims are strong; sanitized recipe does not match final formulas; tail claims conflict with displayed lower/upper fit
consequence: The secondary private example distracts from the reproducible workflow and may mislead scientifically
action: Keep LIPID secondary and 2-4 pages; publish exact data-free preprocessing contracts, formulas, controls, selection steps and producers; test them on the generic fixture; record author-run private artifact hashes without releasing derived data; remove causal/stability claims and require every retained lower/upper/opposite-tail statement to cite a displayed statistic
acceptance: Generic-fixture tests exercise the exact code path; static private hashes and provenance are recorded; manuscript states the exception and makes no public-regeneration claim; every retained tail statement matches its displayed statistic

title: Manuscript does not identify the reviewed software artifact or installability contract
evidence: No reviewed version/commit, license, minimum R, tested platforms, install source, dependency statement, or citation is stated
consequence: Readers cannot identify or install the software intended for review
action: Prepare a Software availability subsection with release-candidate version/commit, license, install command, requirements, tested platforms, documentation/support and citation; reserve final tag/DOI insertion for JSS-035
acceptance: A clean machine installs the release candidate from its stated source and manuscript/package metadata agree on every field

title: Script dependencies, seed registry, and environment isolation are incomplete
evidence: Executed paper/scripts producers are omitted from input hashes/graph; seed registry is unused with a discrepancy; inherited libraries and optional dependencies weaken isolation
consequence: A successful run cannot be attributed completely or repeated reliably
action: Track every executed script/file as a target input; make seeds.csv authoritative and tested; isolate restored libraries and lock optional dependencies used by profiles
acceptance: Input graph includes every executed producer; seeds in outputs equal registry; cold platform runs use only declared environment

title: Figures, tables, and float order are not readable or accessible at normal size
evidence: Dense tables reach 5-7 pt; multi-panel figures have caption-subscale text; several visuals rely on cyan/red; Figure 2 interrupts output; Appendix C-E headings are empty/misowned; Appendix G code and references are interrupted by floats
consequence: Readers cannot evaluate results without zoom and document hierarchy is broken
action: Apply every figure-table-audit.csv disposition, including Figure 2 and Figures 13-18/Tables 19-21; split dense panels/tables, use redundant accessible encodings, and repair empty headings and Appendix G/reference order
acceptance: Each audit row has a dated actual-size print, 100% screen, grayscale, and color-accessibility approval; no heading lacks owned content; no code/output/reference sequence is interrupted

title: Bibliography, citations, code markup, captions, and build compliance need a complete JSS pass
evidence: Six citation keys are unresolved; bibliography has 72 warnings/noisy fields; arXiv macros and non-JSS code/caption conventions remain
consequence: Formal submission and source quality requirements are not met
action: Adopt the current JSS template/macros; resolve every citation; normalize BibTeX; enforce sentence-style headings/captions, labelled references, and code width/markup; review each remaining build warning
acceptance: Zero unresolved citations/references and zero overfull boxes affecting content; a warning ledger marks each remaining benign underfull/float warning approved; the JSS style checklist passes; bibliography contains no database debris

title: Screening, selection, diagnostics, and confirmatory inference are conflated
evidence: AIC/pseudo-observation screens and fixed thresholds are presented as stronger decisions; LIPID p-values follow extensive model selection
consequence: Users may mistake exploratory heuristics for calibrated validation or confirmatory inference
action: Define a staged exploratory-to-confirmatory workflow; label heuristic screens; require sensitivity and post-selection caveats; align help pages and paper
acceptance: Every function is labelled screen/diagnostic/test appropriately; manuscript example distinguishes exploratory choices from final inference

title: Prediction and simulation language exceeds implemented estimands
evidence: Marginal/unconditional point predictions are discussed as if dynamic subject trajectories; response, mu, fitted values, and response mean are not synonymous across families
consequence: Applied users may answer a different longitudinal question than intended
action: Document current prediction as history-unconditional/marginal with an explicit type contract for response, location and any supported response mean; state history-conditioned dynamic prediction as unsupported; narrow all trajectory language
acceptance: Each type states its conditioning set, scale, family support and approximation; two subjects with identical covariates but different histories receive the documented same marginal result; unsupported dynamic requests fail clearly

title: Manifest mapping and figure verification do not yet support exact manuscript claims
evidence: Several public figure hashes differ; checks validate only PNG structure; two inline tables remain manual/pending; some labels do not match TeX
consequence: A successful profile does not prove that the reviewed manuscript contains approved evidence
action: Externalize all public data-backed inline tables; align labels; hash plotted data and plot specifications; define the canonical byte-identical platform or numeric/perceptual tolerance; add explicit visual approval and a deliberate mutation test
acceptance: Every public artifact maps one-to-one to a manuscript label/path; changing a plotted series while preserving PNG validity and dimensions fails verification; renderer drift and evidence changes are distinguished; all declared approval records pass

title: Controlled vocabulary and symbol audit are needed
evidence: Mean/location, fixed/parametric, correlation/dependence/covariance, CDF terminology, and discrete symbols are inconsistent
consequence: Technical meaning is obscured and cross-family interpretation is unsafe
action: Adopt a terminology/style sheet and notation table; run global consistency and symbol-definition audit
acceptance: All symbols are defined once; controlled terms are used consistently; family-specific meanings are preserved

title: Captions, code output, and local prose need copy-editing after restructuring
evidence: Captions contradict plots, code output is low contrast/too long, punctuation and cross-reference styles vary, prose repeats and contains errors
consequence: Even correct results remain hard to interpret
action: After structural edits, make captions self-contained, excerpt code/output, standardize cross-references/spelling/hyphenation and run professional copy-edit
acceptance: Every caption defines data/marks/estimand; code fits text width; style sheet and spell/grammar checks pass

title: Conclusion should state a clear use/do-not-use boundary instead of repeating results
evidence: Discussion repeats simulations and does not consolidate first-order, missingness, inference, and computational boundaries
consequence: Readers leave without a crisp decision rule
action: Rewrite to one page: intended users, supported settings, contraindications, unresolved limitations, and roadmap
acceptance: No paragraph-length repetition of Section 4; every major limitation maps to user guidance

title: Supported family and pair-type routing is incomplete and can select an invalid likelihood
locations: Sections 2.2-2.3; family capability and likelihood routing
evidence: Unsupported discrete/bounded families can enter a continuous path; one homogeneous family per fit and mixed continuous-discrete transitions are not clearly enforced; discrete copula identification is unqualified
consequence: A fit can optimize the wrong objective and users can assume unsupported mixed outcomes
action: Create a versioned capability registry covering family type, parameter links, supported pair contribution and diagnostics; enforce one homogeneous family per fit; reject unsupported bounded/discrete/mixed pair paths before optimization; correct the discrete log contribution and identifiability prose
acceptance: Every registered family/copula combination has a tested route; unsupported combinations fail before optimization with the documented error class; mixed-family inputs fail clearly; manuscript capability table matches the registry

title: Optimizer stop reasons and downstream qualification are not consistently visible
locations: CG/RS fit return paths and standard methods
evidence: CG nonconvergence can be returned silently and downstream inference/output may look ordinary
consequence: Users can report a nonconverged fit as valid
action: Define structured stop reasons for every optimizer; warn with a classed condition on nonconvergence; record gradient/step/objective diagnostics; block or visibly qualify inference, AIC and prediction when required
acceptance: Tests cover every stop reason; every nonconverged fit emits/records the documented condition; summary/print/inference cannot hide the state

title: Fixed and smooth uncertainty are conditional approximations rather than full joint inference
locations: Section 3 inference claims; Appendix B.1.5; sandwich/bootstrap methods
evidence: Fixed Hessian holds smooth coefficients fixed; smooth covariance omits cross-block and smoothing-parameter uncertainty; sandwich scores cover fixed coefficients only; bootstrap targets differ
consequence: Claims of correlation-adjusted standard errors for all parameters are false
action: For this paper, do not implement a new full fixed-smooth covariance engine: inventory every inferential output, label fixed and smooth results conditional on fitted smooth structure, label smooth covariance approximate, define sandwich/bootstrap coefficient blocks and failure handling, and remove all broader joint-inference claims
acceptance: An inference-contract table lists estimand, conditioning, coefficient blocks, assumptions, failure state and validation for every output; targeted conditional-coverage tests pass; global search finds no all-parameters or unconditional joint-inference claim

title: Core documentation and vignettes are not clean-library executable
locations: Rd examples; package vignettes; JSS start vignette
evidence: Principal guidance vignettes are globally unevaluated, the JSS template vignette has undefined objects, and core Rd examples are absent or insufficient
consequence: The software paper can show a workflow that the package documentation does not independently execute
action: Use the same small public dataset as the manuscript; add executable core Rd examples; make the primary fitting, diagnostics, prediction and simulation vignettes evaluate in a clean library; keep only explicitly justified expensive chunks unevaluated
acceptance: R CMD check succeeds in a clean library; named core vignettes evaluate end to end; every unevaluated chunk has a documented cost reason; examples cover the standard-method contracts

title: Practitioner-facing fit scaling and feasibility guidance are missing
evidence: Replication runtime does not explain cost changes with subjects, visits, parameter dimension, smooth basis, family, optimizer and covariance method
consequence: Users cannot decide whether a proposed model is computationally feasible
action: Run a modest precision-driven timing benchmark for a representative continuous and discrete model varying only subjects, visits and smooth basis; report measured hardware/timings and qualitative complexity for family, optimizer and covariance choices
acceptance: A generated timing table states scenario, median/IQR runtime, failures, hardware and package version; manuscript gives bounded qualitative scaling without extrapolating beyond measurements

title: Final accepted package, manuscript and replication state is not tagged and archived
evidence: The reviewed workflow currently exists in a dirty working state and no immutable archive/DOI identifies the final accepted evidence
consequence: No citable immutable artifact currently binds the final software, manuscript, public evidence, and reviewer commands
action: After all scientific, paper, artifact and platform gates pass, create the final tag/archive/DOI and update manuscript metadata without changing analyses
acceptance: Tag is clean; archive checksum and DOI resolve; manuscript, package DESCRIPTION/CITATION, manifest and reviewer commands identify the same version; archived smoke/paper/full/CI evidence matches the tag
